title: Frankfurter Dal Tadka
description: A twist on traditional Indian dal, featuring a spicy frankfurter tadka for added flavor.
instructions: Heat oil for frying in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds, let sizzle for 1-2 seconds.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add grated ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
Add dal and 2 cups of water to the pan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
While dal is cooking, heat oil for frying in a separate pan over medium heat.
Add frankfurter and cook until browned on all sides.
Add garam masala, salt, and 1 cup of water to the pan.
Simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce thickens.
To assemble the dish, place cooked dal in a bowl and top with the frankfurter tadka.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
